parts.name: Sphere
parts.Basic_description: This is the spherical part of the globe, typically made of paper mache or lightweight plastic, representing the Earth's surface with printed maps.
parts.Functional_description: It displays geographical information such as continents, countries, and oceans, and can rotate around its axis for educational use.
parts.Movement_description: It can rotate freely around its axis when mounted on the base.

parts.name: Base Body
parts.Basic_description: This is the base body of the globe, usually made of wood or metal, providing structural support for the rotating sphere.
parts.Functional_description: It holds the sphere in place and allows it to rotate smoothly while maintaining stability on a surface.
parts.Movement_description: It remains stationary and serves as the support structure for the rotating sphere.
